name: Waldorf Pulse 2

channel.note: Global MIDI Channel: OMNI or 1..16 (omni receives all, sends on 1).

programChange.note: Display 001..500 as one range. Firmware readme (v1.14): only bank LSB (CC 32) is read, banks 0..4 = 001..100, 101..200, 201..300, 301..400, 401..500; CC 0 ignored; the program number is clamped to 0..99 inside the bank; the bank stays latched until Reset All Controllers. PC 0 = 001 per user tests (not stated by Waldorf). Program 500 generates a random patch.

setup: No program-change enable exists; bank LSB (CC 32) 0..4 selects the hundred, latched until Reset All Controllers.
Program 500 is the random patch generator.
notes: Factory names from Waldorf's preset list (2016-07-26): 001..410 named, 411..499 INIT, 500 RANDOM.
A secondary changelog says CC 59 = preset panning against the manual's CC 10; left as the manual says.
